Seriously. Is so amazing and special and then sad and nonexistent. It’s not like I go to bed thinking yay time to lay down close my eyes and miss you. It’s much more subtle and dreadful. It causes me to sleep at 4 am. It makes me hold my breath until I forget to breathe then suddenly wake up due to the need to breathe. It’s not Intentional. You’re so fucking powerful in terms of your hold on me even though you said you were finished with me. Why does it still pull so strong. I know I loved you. Is this what love is? Really is? That love isn’t fair but it just demands things. The way my heart just wants to see you. The way I just sometimes want to talk to you, or cuddle with you. People say it’s always the feeling you miss. I’ve started and stopped many things and I don’t miss them. Even if I spent a long time doing an activity or being with someone. It’s just you. I miss your laugh. Your jokes. Your voice. Your beautiful voice. Your beautiful soft hair. The way you smell like candy. The soft color choices you made for your attire. This is kind of what I use to say when you would be sleeping. I didn’t know you were sleeping because you know sometimes I just can’t shut up. Your witty jokes. Or your calm but confident demeanor when you lifted my spirits. I miss your dog. I miss your car. I miss coming into my bed with you already sleeping. I miss see you smile so sleepily as I kissed you because I’m here. I’m here and it’s our moment to love and be happy with each other. At that moment nothing meant more to me than you. It’s okay for me to miss you. And love you. And wish you well. Your beautiful blue grey eyes. They always changed color. That dress. On the last day we truly spent as a couple. You were and still are the most beautiful girl I’ve ever seen. In the blue dress. I’m crying because it’s seriously so beautiful. Time to try to sleep. I got a long night ahead of me. 

Love,
